---
title: "Estimation walkthroughs"
---

Each walkthrough derives one estimator step by step on a small data set: the
objective, the matrices, the solution, the uncertainty and, where it applies,
the likelihood. Each shows the intermediate quantities, and the comparison
notebooks fit the same models in R, statsmodels and phit. The pages show saved
outputs, so reading them needs no Python or R.

## OLS

- [OLS mathematics](ols-math.qmd): derives the estimator and evaluates each
  intermediate quantity on the PHP example data.
- [OLS verification](ols-verification.qmd): estimates identical models in R,
  Python statsmodels and the PHP extension, displays results and checks agreement.

## Binary logistic regression

- [Math walkthrough](logistic-math.qmd): likelihood, matrix calculations, Newton/IRLS and Wald inference.
- [Executed comparison](logistic-verification.qmd): identical models in R, statsmodels and PHP.
- [Verification record](../verifications/logistic.qmd): fixtures, edge cases and tolerances.
- [Scale and performance](../benchmarks/logistic.qmd): standard release benchmarks.

## Probit regression

- [Scale and performance](../benchmarks/probit.qmd): standard release benchmarks.

## Expanded mixed designs and R compatibility

- [Random slopes, penalized least squares and REML](lmm-general-math.qmd): observed
  matrices, covariance dot products, QR elimination, ML/REML determinant terms and
  plug-in fixed-effect covariance on published sleepstudy data.
- [Expanded R and optimizer audit](r-compatibility.qmd): weighted/offset fits,
  grouped binomial trials, both native optimizers and all four actual lme4 wrappers.

## Binomial random-intercept likelihoods

- [Likelihood and integration](logistic-mixed-math.qmd): observed cattle counts,
  log-odds dot products, posterior modes, Laplace/AGQ and joint information.
- [R and independent Python verification](logistic-mixed-verification.qmd):
